name: Ofek Data Center, near Ashdod
developer: Dalia Energy; Serverfarm; Israel Infrastructure Fund (IIF)
notes: Dalia announced a 130MW AI data center outside Ashdod; Globes reports Serverfarm and IIF will build it for Dalia with $1.5B construction investment and possible expansion later.

name: Mega DC MDCIL-5 Idan Hanegev Campus
notes: Official Mega DC site lists Idan Hanegev campus at 180MW total power, 75K sqm, T3/T4 design, onsite substation, liquid cooling support, with RFS in 2028.

name: MedOne Dimona Campus
notes: Facility aggregators list a MedOne Dimona campus/Dimona 01 in southern Israel as a planned or purpose-built data center; operator roadmap includes nationwide expansion but public capacity for Dimona was not verified from a primary page.

name: Mega DC MDCIL-3 MATAM Haifa
notes: Official Mega DC site says MATAM Haifa High-Tech Park project has 20MW under construction, 10MW RFS in 2027, 14K sqm, and is 500m from subsea cable landing.

name: MedOne Tirat HaCarmel Campus
notes: MedOne lists Tirat HaCarmel as its flagship enterprise campus with expansion path; DCD notes MedOne has existing underground facilities including Tirat HaCarmel.

name: MedOne Tirat HaCarmel expansion
notes: MedOne official expansion plan says it is negotiating for adjacent expansion space at Tirat HaCarmel with a path to incremental 21MW IT across two additional facilities.

name: Oracle Israel Cloud Region - Jerusalem underground data center
notes: Oracle's Jerusalem cloud data center is reported as a 14,000 sqm underground bunker in Har Hotzvim, constructed by Bynet; unveiled/opened in October 2021.

name: Bynet Jerusalem of Gold
notes: Bynet official site lists Jerusalem of Gold at 1,650 racks, 8MW, 14,000 sqm, Tier 3.

name: Bynet Jerusalem of Silver
notes: Bynet official site lists Jerusalem of Silver at 320 racks, 1MW, 1,400 sqm, Tier 3.

name: Bynet Jerusalem of Light
notes: Bynet official site lists Jerusalem of Light at 450 racks, 3MW, 1,500 sqm, Tier 3.

name: GTR IS One Petah Tikva
notes: GTR announced a 10.5MW underground data center in Petah Tikva with 4,800 sqm technical space across two subterranean floors; later materials expected full operation by 2023.

name: NED Alpha Campus, Netanya
developer: NED Data Centers; Levinstein Group; Goldacre
notes: NED/Levinstein/Goldacre campus in Netanya is reported as a 35,000 sqm, 42MW AI-ready underground campus; official NED project page describes first phase as 16 of 60MVA.

name: MedOne Kfar Yona Campus
notes: MedOne official pages say two data centers are being built in Kfar Yona; first opens in 2026, second in 2027. Expansion page lists 21MW IT on owned land with first-phase power secured.

name: MedOne Ramle Campus
notes: MedOne official expansion plan lists Ramle with 31.5MW IT across three facilities; DCD notes a 10.5MW Ramla site under construction.

name: Bynet Lod Data Center
notes: Bynet official site lists its LOD underground facility at 120 racks, 1MW, 500 sqm, Tier 3.

name: Bynet Ha'horesh Shoham Data Center
notes: Bynet official site lists Ha'horesh at 1,690 racks, 20MW, 20,000 sqm, Tier 4; Bynet states its data center sites include Shoham.

name: Mega DC MDCIL-4 Beit Shemesh Campus
notes: Official Mega DC site lists Beit Shemesh campus at 240MW total power, 115K sqm; 120MW under construction and 60MW RFS in 2027.

name: Mega Or / Nebius Modi'in AI Data Center
notes: Jerusalem Post reported Mega Or and Nebius launched an AI data center in Modi'in with 8MW electrical power and 4,000 Nvidia GPUs, 25% allocated to Israel Innovation Authority national supercomputer operations.

name: Bynet TLV A
notes: Bynet official site lists TLV A at 75 racks and 0.5MW.

name: Bynet TLV B
notes: Bynet official site lists TLV B at 76 racks and 0.5MW.

name: Serverfarm ISR1 North Tel Aviv
notes: Serverfarm official site describes ISR1 as its first Middle East-based data center in North Tel Aviv, offering scalable capacity and connectivity near transport hubs.

name: Microsoft Israel cloud datacenter region
notes: Microsoft announced its first cloud region in Israel, anticipated for Azure availability starting in 2021; exact datacenter sites/capacity are not public, so mapped to Tel Aviv market only at region level.

name: AWS Israel (Tel Aviv) Region
notes: AWS confirmed an Israel (Tel Aviv) Region with three Availability Zones planned to open in the first half of 2023; physical AZ sites and capacities are not public.

name: Google Cloud Israel region
notes: Times of Israel reported Google's first local cloud region for Israel went live under Project Nimbus; exact datacenter locations and capacities are not public.

name: Mega DC / Nvidia Mevo Carmel AI Data Center
developer: Mega DC (Mega Or); Nvidia prospective tenant/operator
notes: Globes reported Mega DC was in talks with Nvidia to build a 64MW data center in Mevo Carmel industrial park near Yokneam; article also says Nvidia was building a second Mevo Carmel data center for internal use.

name: Nvidia Yokneam HPC and AI data center
notes: Nvidia job posting for Yokneam seeks an HPC and AI Data Center Engineer; Ynet reports Nvidia operates its first supercomputer in Israel in Yokneam and is expanding local build-out. Capacity not public.
